subject: Archer portal evidence handoff and delegation plan
messages:
From: Alice Morton <alice@cloudfabric.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudFabric Security Team <security@cloudfabric.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Archer portal evidence & delegation for CloudFabric

Hi Markus / Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — CloudFabric is ready to start the Archer profile onboarding and we want to get the evidence flow and delegation model set up so our SOC 2 audit team can pull/verify items without manual follow-ups. Specific asks: 

- Can Redwood provision a delegated role in Archer (or provide a pre-signed upload flow) for our evidence ingestion?
- We need a short delegation matrix (who can upload vs who can attest) and a recommended presign/upload window.
- Can you map which Archer fields correspond to SOC 2 and where Redwood plans to surface short attestation notes?

I attached our internal onboarding checklist to show the items we expect to upload first. Goal: complete initial handoff and a two-week evidence rotation schedule.

Would appreciate a short plan + owner table (1–3 bullets) by the end of today so I can align with our internal security ops.

Thanks,
Alice Morton
Senior Security Program Manager
CloudFabric
[Attachment: archer_onboarding_checklist.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Alice Morton <alice@cloudfabric.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Oct 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Archer portal evidence & delegation for CloudFabric

Hi Alice —

Appreciate the checklist, that helps. Quick plan below (high level) — will sync details with Olga for the delegation matrix and with Naomi for SOC 2 mapping: 

1) Delegation approach
   - Option A: Redwood creates a scoped \"upload-only\" service account in Archer for CloudFabric (recommended for short-term).
   - Option B: Pre-signed S3 uploads with proof manifest (preferred if you want retention outside Archer).
   Owner: Markus (Redwood) — initial config + test upload by 10/05.

2) Evidence mapping (SOC 2 => Archer fields)
   - Naomi will provide a one-page crosswalk (field -> SOC control) and suggested attestation note template.
   Owner: Naomi (Redwood) — deliver by EOD 10/04.

3) Delegation matrix & roles
   - Olga will prepare a CSV showing who at CloudFabric can upload vs who can attest. We will use the same roles to seed Archer's role assignments.
   Owner: Olga (Redwood) — delegate matrix by 10/04.

4) Presign/upload window
   - Proposed: 7-day presign tokens with daily rotation; allow 3 concurrent uploads. We'll provide a short policy doc.
   Owner: Markus (Redwood) — policy draft attached.

Next steps: Naomi and Olga, can you confirm the deliverable commitments above? Alice — if that timeline works, we'll schedule a 30-minute handoff on Tue/10/05.

-Markus
VP, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: archer_presign_policy.md (md, 6KB)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Morton <alice@cloudfabric.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Archer portal evidence & delegation for CloudFabric

Markus / Naomi / Alice — attaching the delegation matrix CSV (first pass). A few implementation notes: 

- I created three roles: uploader, reviewer (can add attestations), and steward (full update rights).
- For Archer we recommend assigning the uploader role to your automation service account and reviewers to two named individuals.
- If you prefer SSO mapping, provide the SAML attribute for groups and we can link to Archer's groups instead of creating local users.

CSV attachment includes columns: role, redwood_role, cloudfabric_principal, example_email, initial_effective_date.

Please review and reply with any changes. I'll incorporate and produce a presign key rotation schedule.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Security Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: delegation_matrix_20271004.csv (csv, 3KB)]

Date: Tue, 5 Oct 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Archer portal evidence & delegation for CloudFabric

Thanks all — this looks good and the timeline works for us. A couple quick confirmations before the handoff: 

- We'll proceed with Option B (pre-signed uploads) because our retention pipeline keeps a copy in our archive.
- Naomi, if you can send the SOC 2 crosswalk by EOD today that would let our audit team pre-tag the incoming docs.
- Olga, the delegation matrix looks right; can you add a column for "escalation contact" (name + email) so our ops team knows who to reach for upload failures?

Scheduling: Tue 10/05 at 11:00 PT (30m) works — please send a calendar invite. Thanks for the fast turnaround.

Best,
Alice
Senior Security Program Manager
CloudFabric
